InformalDependency.description:
A dependency the *book* asserts, before any Lean exists.

Report 01 §B6: the summer recorded these in prose only -- 176 of 226 declarations were
cited by name in another declaration's docstring and by nothing else, while 224 of 226
had zero Lean-code references. The informal graph and the formal graph never met.

resolved.description: False when the reference could not be resolved to an id.
resolved.title: Resolved

target_id.description: Declaration id, when the reference resolves.
target_id.title: Target Id

InformalDependency.title: InformalDependency

MathlibCandidate.description:
A Mathlib name the annotator believes is relevant.

``status`` carries the single highest-signal token in the summer corpus: 446 instances
of ``MISSING -- must be built`` across ten chapters. ``verified`` records whether the
name was actually checked; report 02 §B7 measured the cost of not checking -- 12
declarations written, proved, then archived as exact Mathlib duplicates.

verified.description: True only if the identifier was mechanically confirmed.
verified.title: Verified

MathlibCandidate.title: MathlibCandidate

OpenQuestion.description: Something the annotator could not settle and a human may need to.
OpenQuestion.title: OpenQuestion

ProofStep.description: One step of the book's printed proof, in the book's own terms.

uses.description: Declaration ids or raw references this step invokes.
uses.title: Uses

ProofStep.title: ProofStep

Provenance.description:
Where an artifact came from and what it was produced against.

Report 01 §B4 is the reason this exists and is required on every agent-produced
artifact: the summer's annotations asserted repository facts with no record of the
repository state they were written against, and those assertions went silently false.

context_package_id.description: ContextPackage this artifact was generated from.
context_package_id.title: Context Package Id

corpus_version.description: Corpus registry version this was generated against.
corpus_version.title: Corpus Version

input_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the exact input content (staleness check).
input_fingerprint.title: Input Fingerprint

model.description: Model id, or None if deterministic.
model.title: Model

producer.description: Component that produced the artifact, e.g. 'annotator'.
producer.title: Producer

provider.description: LLM provider, or None for deterministic producers.
provider.title: Provider

Provenance.title: Provenance

SourceItemKind.description:
What the textbook calls this item.

Kept separate from :class:`LeanDeclarationKind`: the book's `definition` may become a
Lean `def`, `abbrev`, `structure` or `Prop`, and an `exercise` may become a `theorem`.
Conflating them is how source identity gets lost (report 01 §B2).
SourceItemKind.title: SourceItemKind

description: Machine-readable annotation for exactly one source item.

concepts.description: Closed-vocabulary concept tags used for retrieval.
concepts.title: Concepts

figure_dependencies.description: Figures the argument relies on. Stage 0 drops figures by design (204 sites); recording the dependency lets a reviewer see when a proof reasons from a picture that is not in the corpus.
figure_dependencies.title: Figure Dependencies

formalization_hints.description: Representation hazards. The annotation's strongest observed output.
formalization_hints.title: Formalization Hints

local_definition_hints.description: Declaration ids of prior local definitions this statement needs.
local_definition_hints.title: Local Definition Hints

proof_strategy.description: One- to three-sentence summary of the book's argument.
proof_strategy.title: Proof Strategy

source_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the SourceItem this annotates; detects staleness.
source_fingerprint.title: Source Fingerprint

stated_hypotheses.description: Every hypothesis the book states, including ones stated once at the top of a section and inherited silently. Report 01 §D1: five theorems in the summer corpus are FALSE as formalized because a prose hypothesis had no field to travel in. This field carries a mandatory human gate.
stated_hypotheses.title: Stated Hypotheses

terminology.description: Terms the book introduces or relies on here.
terminology.title: Terminology
